name: landing-page
title: Landing Page
description: Design and build a single-purpose, high-conversion landing page.
when_to_use: Campaign pages, single offers, lead-generation pages.
instructions: One primary conversion goal; every section either builds the case for it or removes an objection.
Primary CTA above the fold on mobile and repeated after key proof points; phone as a secondary path for service businesses.
Short form (ask only what the business needs), clear next-step microcopy, no navigation leaks that distract from the goal.
